title: Who to Vote for to Stop Aggressive Taxation?
body:
I happen to be in the accursed top 5-10 percent earners in Australia. By all political narratives I should be rich and living like a king. The reality is far from it and every year I am inching closer to living pay check to pay check:
Tax changes aggressively penalizing middle income earners: scraped stage 3, no indexation on brackets regardless of runaway inflation, CGT on stocks and making low barrier investment options unattractive…
Eroding govt benifits: FTB and lower childcare subsidy, private health insurance requirements and MLS and a million other taxes.
Tax (a specific group of) people vs Tax the resources mentality, promoting financial divide / toll poppyism
I voted for ALP, I don't think I will again.
I don't support LNP but they are arguably better when it comes to taxation in recent history. ONP is hard pass. Greens similarly are hard on taxing middle class.
Question: What real options do we have in Australia to vote for a party that aligns to favorable taxation outcomes for the middle class in the current climate ?
+ Cookie points to having decent center left leaning policies.
Example breakdown because you keep asking:
Income : ~10k post tax
Outgoing: Childcare ~3.5k, Mortgage ~ 3.5 - 4k, : Left 2.5-3k (grocery, utilities, fuel, health + property + car insurance, hidden tax like expenses: council rates and tolls, property/car maintenance)
